\section*{Dubins paper grid}

Dubins, 21 world models (base sigreg / jac / jac+pull $\times$ safety reg), three world-model seeds each (3072, 1, 2; jac uses 3072, 1, 100), as in LeWM (results averaged over 3 training seeds). Every world model is trained for 50 epochs on the same dataset. Mean ($\pm$ std) over the seeds done; a blank cell is not done yet; $^\dagger$ = fewer than 3 seeds done (the Seeds column lists them; a number in parentheses in a CEM cell is the number of seeds averaged). Rows: 1 = sigreg, 2 = jac, 3 = jac+pull base; a = no safety reg, b = adv$_h$, c = adv$_h$ with a linear internal head, d = adv$_\lambda$, e = adv$_\lambda$ encoder-only, f = adv$_h$ encoder-only, g = adv$_h$ with a linear internal head, encoder-only.
